Author: Serpens66
Name: Cheat Mod
Description: Provides optional host-controlled cheats for Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Adds standalone support for the shared Script Extender per-player identity workaround.
Run the mana tick updater only while Vanilla Extreme Powers are enabled, and react immediately when the Script Extender activation setter is used.
Added the host-controlled Endless Extreme Powers option, which refills every living human player's Extreme Powers mana once per 40 simulation ticks.
